name: Context Switcher
description: Context Switcher is an MCP connector that helps Claude manage and navigate different “contexts” in a structured way, instead of treating every conversation as a blank slate. Teams can define reusable contexts—such as “RFP evaluation,” “customer support triage,” “product discovery,” or “risk review”—and use Context Switcher to move between them without losing the underlying reasoning. When invoked, the connector can load the right criteria, constraints, and reference materials for the chosen context, then guide Claude to apply the appropriate decision lens to the current problem. This makes it easier for product, operations, and proposal teams to keep their work organized, avoid mixing use cases, and ensure that each workflow runs with the right assumptions. Context Switcher is maintained by Reasoning.Services and designed to work alongside other MCP servers that provide structured reasoning, document access, or workflow automation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Context Switcher to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Context Switcher to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://reasoning.services/tools/context-switcher/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Context Switcher MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Context Switcher provides these MCP tools: add_perspective, analyze_from_perspectives, analyze_from_perspectives_stream, current_session, list_templates, recommend_perspectives, start_context_analysis, and synthesize_perspectives.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Context Switcher?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Context Switcher in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Context Switcher MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Context Switcher requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Context Switcher is developed by Reasoning.Services. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
